task: Geohash toolkit with cover-vs-brute-force differential tests
reasoning_summary: Geohash cells are addressed by integer (ix,iy) indices so neighbours, wrap-around and box cover are index arithmetic, and encode/decode only interleave bits. Tests mix literal known hashes with property tests and a brute-force enumeration oracle for cover. Debugging found one real bug (wrapped boxes narrower than one cell double-counted the world) and several wrong hand-written expectations.
